subject: Order form questions — invoicing sequencing & entity split
messages:
From: Lars Nielsen <lars.nielsen@novaproduct.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 13:15:00 +0200
Subject: Order form questions — invoicing sequencing & entity split

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the draft order form. Procurement reviewed the commercials and we have two operational asks before we can route the PO to finance:

1) Invoice sequencing — our legal/tax team requires that invoices be issued to NL entity (NovaProduct BV) for services consumed in EMEA. We need confirmation you can send invoices to that entity and include VAT handling in line with reverse-charge where applicable.

2) Entity split — for tax reasons we may need a portion of the commitment (first tranche) invoiced to our UK subsidiary and the remainder to the Dutch entity. Can Redwood support split invoicing (two invoices per period) and tie each invoice to the same order/PO?

We can provide a signed PO once the above is confirmed and after minimal redlines to the order form that preserve pricing/schedule.

Attaching our standard PO template for reference.

Regards,
Lars Nielsen
Head of Procurement — NovaProduct Inc.
procurement@novaproduct.com
+44 20 7946 0123
(Attachment: NovaProduct_PO_78921.pdf)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Lars Nielsen <lars.nielsen@novaproduct.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 14:03:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Order form questions — invoicing sequencing & entity split

Hi Lars — appreciate the quick review and the PO template. Short answers up front: yes, we can invoice to NovaProduct BV and we can split invoices by entity, but we need to confirm accounting workflow and contract language to ensure VAT/responsibility is clear.

Next steps I propose:
- Loop in Legal to propose a minimal redline that documents invoice recipient(s) and VAT treatment. (@Kimberly / @Karthik can you confirm whether finance needs any extra fields on the invoice to map to split billing?)
- If that looks good to you, we’ll accept the PO and send a consolidated schedule of invoices (dates, amounts, invoice-to entity) so your AP team can set up routing.

I’m attaching the order form with a few placeholder notes — Kimberly will share a redline for legal acceptance.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
(Attachment: redwood_orderform_note_v1.pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 15:10:00 +02:00
Subject: RE: Order form questions — invoicing sequencing & entity split

Rachel / Karthik,

Thanks — I reviewed Lars' asks and drafted a minimal redline to the Order Form and a short invoicing addendum. Key points included:
- Invoice recipient(s): define Primary Invoice Entity = NovaProduct BV (NL) and Secondary Invoice Entity = NovaProduct UK Ltd (UK).
- VAT: include clause that customer is responsible for VAT/withholding and that Redwood will indicate VAT registration numbers; where reverse-charge applies, customer will self-account.
- Split invoicing: Redwood will issue separate invoices that reference the same PO and order form line items; specify mapping table (invoice number -> legal entity -> billing amount).
- Net terms: propose Net 45 from invoice date (so everyone's aligned).
- Invoicing cadence: monthly in arrears; first invoice prorated to activation date.

I attached the redline PDF and a one-page invoicing addendum template. If procurement confirms those elements, we can accept the PO and finance will generate the invoice schedule.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
(Attachment: redwood_orderform_redline_20260828.pdf)

Hi Kimberly / Rachel,

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the draft redline — that looks largely in line with what our tax team expects. Two clarifications from our side:

1) Can you include NovaProduct's VAT number on each invoice line so our VAT reclaim team can reconcile?
2) For the split invoice approach, will each invoice contain a clear reference to the same order line (e.g., OF-2026-78921) and a mapping table so our AP system can auto-apply?

We’ve attached our signed PO (PO# 78921) but will hold sending it to accounts-payable until we get the final order form + invoicing addendum.

If you can confirm the above, I’ll get finance to sign and route the PO.

Best,
Lars
